nodes.label: MINIMAL TEXT: Always emphasize that text
nodes.text: MINIMAL TEXT: Always emphasize that text is sparse, essential-only, integrated as visual element - never lengthy

nodes.label: This is VERY IMPORTANT: The reference
nodes.text: This is VERY IMPORTANT: The reference must be refined so it enhances the work's depth without announcing itself. Think like a jazz musician quoting another song - only those who know will catch it, but everyone appreciates the music.

nodes.label: These are instructions for creating design
nodes.text: These are instructions for creating design philosophies - aesthetic movements that are then EXPRESSED VISUALLY. Output only .md files, .pdf files, and .png files.

nodes.label: philosophy must emphasize: Visual expres…
nodes.text: The philosophy must emphasize: Visual expression. Spatial communication. Artistic interpretation. Minimal words.

nodes.label: philosophy must guide the next version
nodes.text: The philosophy must guide the next version to express ideas VISUALLY, not through text. Information lives in design, not paragraphs.

nodes.label: EXPERT CRAFTSMANSHIP: Repeatedly emphasi…
nodes.text: EXPERT CRAFTSMANSHIP: Repeatedly emphasize the final work must look meticulously crafted, labored over with care, the product of countless hours by someone at the top of their field

nodes.label: For any type of content, even
nodes.text: For any type of content, even if the user requests something for a movie/game/book, the approach should still be sophisticated. Never lose sight of the idea that this should be art, not something that's cartoony or amateur.
